lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Emberguard! Boots on! We march at first light!

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.text: Rider at the gate! Make way!

lines.speaker: dancer
lines.text: Come on, my queen! One dance!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: And me? He gave me what was left over. The dark. As if it were a kindness.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Everyone tells my story wrong. Let me try.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: I have heard "stop" all my life.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: I kept something. A candle. A knife. A stone that still beats in my hand.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: I took the dark and taught it to kneel. I took knives, and a woman who never misses.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: I was a gravedigger's son. I grew up among the dead. They were better company.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: It whispers. Let it. I am the one who listens, and I am the one who decides.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Keep it warm for me. The other three will come for it now.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Light all the candles you like. The dark just gets a better view.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Little Vessa. You came a long way to lose something you never had.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Look at it. The last green country. Flowers to the knee. The Master's garden.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Put it down. That crown was never meant for someone who throws fire at her problems.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: She missed. Emberfall. Then the Hollow. I lost, and lost, and every time I lost,

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: That is how a gravedigger's son grows strong: he never puts the shovel down.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: The Master found me reading tombstones by one candle. He said: this one, too.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Then he vanished and left us nothing. So I took. That is the whole secret.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: They will stand there and tell me to stop. Fire. Roots. An old man's storm.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Too. Fourth of four. Fire was his joy, ice his patience, the wood his heart.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Burn her forest down, and it grows back. Every spring. Every time.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: But he is never full. Whatever he holds, he wants more.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: But he waits too long, and trusts slow ice more than quick friends.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: But she never waits. And fire that will not wait burns its own house.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: But she will not take a side, not even while the world burns.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Dragons great and small filled its sky, and not one breathed in anger.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Give her a wall, and she will burn a door through it.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: He raised four apprentices, and gave each of them a kingdom.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: He thinks I gave him leftovers. I gave the dark to the one it could not frighten.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: His citadel rose above the clouds, a city of towers, bridges and bells.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: I know this tale well, child. I was that wizard.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: I left him my coldest secret. Torvald was my patience.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: I loved all four of them. And still, they went to war.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: I would say: show me again. And she always did. Ysolde was my heart.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Kings brought him their quarrels, and went home as friends.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Malrik. I found him reading tombstones by the light of one candle.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Nothing breaks him. Not armies, not winters. Not time.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Nothing is hidden from him. The dark itself comes when he calls.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Once upon a time, the strongest wizard of all time ruled the world.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Still, she laughed like sunrise. Vessa was my joy.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Then, between one breath and the next, he was gone.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: They called him only the Master. For a thousand years, he kept the peace.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Torvald, the eldest. Where he stands, the ice holds, and so does the line.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Vessa, the youngest. She lit her first spark before she could spell her name.

lines.speaker: master
lines.text: Ysolde. I found her coaxing a sapling through the frost.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.text: All of it. I saw it burn.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.text: She said... remember. She warned you.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.text: The Ember Queen? Which one is...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Far away, three apprentices feel the crown wake up, and begin to worry.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Master is gone. His crown is not.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Westwatch fire rises. Riders who remember the old kingdom ride to meet it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three flames answer. The seal cracks, and the old wardens wake up grumpy.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Free at last! Buy something, would you? Shadow soldiers are terrible customers. They never pay, they just loom.

lines.speaker: reveler
lines.text: To Vessa! To the Ember Queen!

lines.speaker: shade
lines.text: The keep sleeps. So should you.

lines.speaker: shade
lines.text: They will not see me coming.

lines.speaker: unit_bleakbow
lines.text: [whisper] I see them. They don't see me.

lines.speaker: unit_bloomtender
lines.text: I would rather heal, but fine.

lines.speaker: unit_cinder_arbalest
lines.text: Line them up. One bolt, two holes.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Eccomi. Il più forte è arrivato.

lines.speaker: unit_flame_guard
lines.text: Venite qui, se avete il coraggio!

lines.speaker: unit_hoarlight_magebow
lines.text: A needle of frost for you.

lines.speaker: unit_nightblood_reaver
lines.text: 您过奖了，我只是个小兵。

lines.speaker: unit_nightbolt
lines.text: A bolt of night, at your word.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Allá voy, con la frente en alto.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: Mi escudo jamás se ha rendido.

lines.speaker: unit_rimeshield
lines.text: ¿Sí? El escudo más noble del norte.

lines.speaker: unit_shadow_knight
lines.text: My blade is sworn to Malrik.

lines.speaker: unit_shardguard
lines.text: Where I walk, the ice holds.

lines.speaker: unit_stormbottle_genie
lines.text: Out of the bottle at last!

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: Fine. There better be a fight there.

lines.speaker: unit_thornling
lines.text: You looking at me? Let's go, then.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: An Ember Crown, in a place called Emberfall. I'm not saying it was left for me. I'm not NOT saying it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: But her people have no one else. I need you. All of you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Hold on, Ysolde. Fire is coming.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I know you're tired. I know we just won.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I'm here for the crown, not a lecture. Fine. Both.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One dance. Then I'm eating everything.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: One lit. Malrik, you still dress like a funeral that got lost on the way.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Tell the others... I was winning.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The watch fires are out. All of them.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Then it's in the right hands. I throw fire at ALL my problems.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Three braziers, one seal. How hard can it be to light things? It's my whole personality.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Who walks the wall at this hour?

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: You are a long way from the dark, shade.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: I felled a mountain yesterday, girl. I'll clap.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: The spark first, girl. Then the storm.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: A tall man with a burning hem found me coaxing a sapling through the frost.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: He said: show me again. So I did, for twenty years, until he was gone.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: I knelt in the black, and I waited. Something green came up. It always does.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: I was born on that hill, the year nothing grew. Not one blade of grass.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: In spring it came up green. I have never forgotten how that felt.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Last winter they burned my wood and froze the ashes. My army with it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Let them come. Cut it. Burn it. Freeze it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Malrik stands up there with his candle, his stone, and Torvald's winter.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: Malrik tells his life as a list of wounds. Mine is a list of winters.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: My mother buried seed in the snow. The village laughed. I watched it sleep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: That is my strength. Not fire. Not knives. I come back. Every spring. Every time.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: The Master planted this country with his own hands. He left it to me to keep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.text: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow. Slow is how an oak outlives an army.
